question: o04
q: How many people tapped on at Central station last Friday?

transcript.answer:
I can't get that. My Opal data doesn't cover Central station, and it doesn't give daily counts for any single station.

The Commute Pulse tool only covers these centres: Sydney CBD, North Sydney, Chatswood, Macquarie Park, Strathfield and Parramatta. It reports monthly aggregates, such as Friday-to-midweek evening tap-on ratios and Tue–Thu evening tap-ons per day, rather than station-level or daily totals. So I can't tell you how many people tapped on at Central last Friday (16 October 2026).

For that number, you'd need Transport for NSW's Opal tap-on data directly, which is published at station level. I can pull the Sydney CBD return-to-office trend if that would help as context.
